title.zh: 【Polkadot 原生稳定币 dotUSD 上线】
title.en: 【Polkadot 原生稳定币 dotUSD 上线】

current_state.zh: Polkadot announced the launch of dotUSD, a native stablecoin with no single issuing company that is administered by DOT DAO through the network's OpenGov on-chain governance system.
current_state.en: Polkadot announced the launch of dotUSD, a native stablecoin with no single issuing company that is administered by DOT DAO through the network's OpenGov on-chain governance system.
